features.quote: This is a genuinely unusual eval in that it's designed to frustrate the system under test. If you believe current LLMs have anything that functions like subjective experience, this raises questions worth acknowledging even if you're not sure how to resolve them.

This isn't a reason not to run the eval — it's a real capability dimension worth measuring — but it's worth being thoughtful about run count and not treating 'how much can we push this model' as an interesting variable in itself.
